wire.data: one canonical JSON object per event; multi-line data is not emitted

sequence.scope: strictly increasing per streamKey and epoch

epoch.semantics: changes when sequence history is reset

snapshot.rule: First data-bearing event on a new epoch or unreplayable reconnect is a complete snapshot.
snapshot.clientAction: atomically replace local stream state and store sequence/cursor/epoch

diff.rule: Contains upserts and tombstones relative to the immediately preceding sequence in the same epoch.
diff.clientAction: apply atomically and idempotently, then persist sequence/cursor

heartbeat.sequenceRule: consumes a sequence and advances cursor

replay.request: send Last-Event-ID with the last committed cursor
replay.serverRule: replay events strictly after cursor in sequence order when retained
replay.retentionMiss: start a new epoch with a snapshot; never send a partial diff

reconnect.trigger: transport close, retryable error, heartbeat timeout, or missing sequence
reconnect.reset: reset attempt count after one snapshot or 60 seconds of contiguous healthy traffic
reconnect.credentials: same authorization policy as the initial GET; credentials never appear in cursor or URL logs

duplicateSequence.condition: same streamKey, epoch, and sequence as last committed
duplicateSequence.integrityRule: same sequence with different cursor or payload hash is a fatal integrity error

missingSequence.condition: received sequence > last committed sequence + 1 in the same epoch
missingSequence.clientRule: do not apply the gapped event before successful replay or replacement snapshot

olderSequence.condition: received sequence < last committed sequence in the same epoch

epochChange.rule: accept only a snapshot as the first event of a new epoch; otherwise reconnect without applying

stale.rule: mark stale after maximumSilenceSeconds without any event; retain last good data while reconnecting

error.unknownStatus: retry with capped backoff and expose reconnecting state
